purpose: Allow constrained assemblies spanning translation mounts, exact distance joints, slack distance limits, world-axis translation locks, slack world-axis translation limits, fixed world-space direction locks and slack fixed-direction limits to opt into deterministic intra-component collision isolation during the preserved donor-core collision stage.

properties.options: optional isolation enabled flag plus nested composer options

limitations: isolation applies to whole connected constraint components rather than direct edges only
slack distance-limit edges still join isolation topology while physically slack
axis-lock edges join topology even though orthogonal translation remains free
slack axis-limit edges still join isolation topology while physically slack
fixed-direction lock edges join topology even though perpendicular translation remains free and their direction remains fixed in world space
slack fixed-direction limit edges join isolation topology even though projected range-interior and perpendicular motion remain physically free
components containing any nonzero caller collision.group are skipped rather than overridden
temporary groups affect only donor-core collision-stage grouping and are restored before return
no angular inertia, rotating local anchors, hinge, full slider/prismatic, rotational weld, motor or gear semantics

proves: legacy component suppression, caller-group preservation, deterministic allocation/restoration and replay
an enabled fixed-direction-limit edge forms an isolation component even while slack, preserves one donor-core step and restores caller collision groups afterward

truth.basis: Component-wide topology and its difference from physical correction are explicit for slack limits, axis locks, fixed-direction locks and fixed-direction limits.

agency.basis: Isolation remains explicit and caller-controlled and never overwrites nonzero caller group semantics.

continuity.basis: The existing temporary-group mechanism is extended to the seventh known edge family without touching the donor source.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The extension reuses deterministic connected-component discovery and keeps ambiguous existing collision semantics fail-safe.
